circle.label: circle
circle.description: A round shape with no sides and no corners: every point on it is the same distance from the middle.

oval.label: oval
oval.description: A stretched circle, like an egg: round all the way, with no sides and no corners.

triangle.label: triangle
triangle.description: A shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners; this one has all three sides the same length.

square.label: square
square.description: A shape with 4 straight sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners.

rectangle.label: rectangle
rectangle.description: A shape with 4 straight sides and 4 square corners; the sides across from each other are the same length.

star.label: star
star.description: A shape with 5 points that stick out; it has 10 short straight sides and 10 corners.

heart.label: heart
heart.description: A curved shape with two round bumps on top and one point at the bottom.
heart.note: A heart has no straight sides; it has one point at the bottom.

diamond.label: diamond
diamond.description: A shape with 4 straight sides all the same length, standing on a corner; its math name is rhombus.

semicircle.label: semicircle
semicircle.description: Half of a circle: one curved side, one straight side and 2 corners.
semicircle.note: One side is straight and one side is curved.

pentagon.label: pentagon
pentagon.description: A shape with 5 straight sides and 5 corners.

hexagon.label: hexagon
hexagon.description: A shape with 6 straight sides and 6 corners, like a honeycomb cell.

octagon.label: octagon
octagon.description: A shape with 8 straight sides and 8 corners, like a stop sign.

crescent.label: crescent
crescent.description: A curved shape like a thin moon, with two points.
crescent.note: Both sides are curved; it has two points.

right_triangle.label: right triangle
right_triangle.description: A triangle with one square corner, like the corner of a page.

trapezoid.label: trapezoid
trapezoid.description: A shape with 4 straight sides and 4 corners; the top and bottom sides point the same way but are different lengths.

parallelogram.label: parallelogram
parallelogram.description: A slanted rectangle: 4 straight sides, the sides across from each other the same length, and no square corners.

kite.label: kite
kite.description: A shape with 4 straight sides: two short sides on top and two long sides below, like a flying kite.

quarter_circle.label: quarter circle
quarter_circle.description: A quarter of a circle: two straight sides, one curved side and 3 corners, one of them square.
quarter_circle.note: Two sides are straight and one side is curved.

arrow.label: arrow
arrow.description: A shape that points the way: 7 straight sides and 7 corners.

cross.label: cross
cross.description: A plus sign shape: 12 straight sides that are all the same length and 12 corners.
cross.note: 8 of its corners are square corners that point out; 4 point in.

heptagon.label: heptagon
heptagon.description: A shape with 7 straight sides and 7 corners.

ring.label: ring
ring.description: A circle with a round hole in the middle, like a donut.
ring.note: It has two round edges: one outside and one around the hole.
